result.reason: The clause adopts successive 12-month renewals, a 30-day non-renewal deadline, and a 60-day Vendor reminder, satisfying those elements of the preferred position. However, it contains no cap on renewal price increases. It therefore reaches neither the preferred cap of the lesser of CPI and 3% nor the fallback cap of 5%. The changes are otherwise targeted, preserve the original bilateral non-renewal right, and are professionally drafted.
